subject: GCP marketplace listing — blockers, evidence handoff, and canary plan
body:
From: Maya Singh <maya@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbus-analytics.com>, GCP Partner PM <gcp-partner@google.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP listing intake + timing constraints

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the intro. Quick recap: Nimbus wants to get the Redwood listing into GCP Marketplace (SaaS listing) and qualify for co-sell within the next 8 weeks. We ran the intake and there are a couple of blockers on our side (SAML integration evidence and a questions list from GCP security).

Can we lock a short triage call today or tomorrow to align on who owns what and what evidence you need from us? I attached the intake pack from Nimbus (see referenced attachments).

High level asks:
- Confirm the listing playbook step owners (partner vs vendor).
- Estimate how long Redwood needs to provide SAML audit screenshot + hosting diagram.
- Agree a canary/co-sell pilot plan (1-2 accounts) while listing is in review.

We’re sensitive to timing because a fiscal push from Nimbus is scheduled for mid-October and they want the listing live before the campaign.

Thanks,
Maya
--
Maya Singh
Head of Partnerships | Nimbus Analytics
maya@nimbus-analytics.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP listing intake + timing constraints

Thanks Maya — putting eyes on this and looping the PM/partner team.

I can do a 30-minute sync today at 3pm PT or tomorrow 9am PT. Proposed agenda:
1) Clarify GCP security checklist items Nimbus still needs
2) Owner map for each intake item (redwood vs Nimbus vs GCP)
3) Canary plan for two pilot accounts: requirements & rollback
4) Next steps and dates (we’ll add milestones to HubSpot)

Attachments I’m dropping into the thread: our internal GCP listing checklist (gcp_listing_checklist.xlsx) and a brief evidence template for SAML (evidence-scan_SAML.pdf). Karthik, Vanessa — can you confirm the SLA for us to produce the SAML screenshots and whether ops will need a readiness window?

-Vivek
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

On Tue, Aug 18, 2026 at 10:19 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai> wrote:

> Vivek / Maya —
>
> Thanks for the context. I reviewed Nimbus’s preliminary security questionnaire; two notes from the infra/serving side:
>
> - SAML evidence: we can provide assertion examples and the SP metadata. Ops will need a 5-business-day window to pull auth logs for the sample timeframe. If Nimbus can enable a staging SSO test tenant, that speeds the process.
>
> - KV cache/latency: GCP requires a short performance snapshot for the listing. We can provide a 48-hour token-level latency/throughput sample from our staging cluster (redwood-staging-gcp-us).
>
> I’ve attached a checklist with which items we own vs. Nimbus. Also flagging internal dependency: product needs to sign off on the canary rollback policy (automatic fallback to smaller model variant) — Vanessa, could you confirm product acceptance criteria and whether we should file a quick RFC?
>
> Karthik
> Staff Product PM, Redwood Inference
> karthik@redwood.ai
>
> -----Original Message-----
> From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
> To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
> Cc: Maya Singh <maya@nimbus-analytics.com>, GCP Partner PM <gcp-partner@google.com>
> Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:06:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: GCP listing intake + timing constraints
>
> +1 on the timeline — we should treat Nimbus as a pilot prospect for our co-sell path.
>
> Vanessa here — product/ops acceptance criteria (initial list):
> - Evidence: SAML metadata, auth logs (5 days), hosting diagram, and PCI/PHI handling statement
> - Canary: 2 pilot customer accounts (one low-risk internal trial, one live account from Nimbus)
> - Fallback: automatic traffic steering to a CPU-backed model for degraded performance situations
>
> Proposed immediate actions:
> 1) Vivek schedule the triage call (30m) and invite Nimbus engineering + our infra oncall
> 2) Karthik to attach the checklist (done) and flag any infra constraints in HubSpot (ticket GCP-123456)
> 3) Naomi to confirm whether Marketplace listing fee waiver applies for pilot co-sell (Naomi, can you confirm?)
>
> Forwarding to GCP Partner PM for visibility and ask them to surface any listing queue constraints.
>
> -Vanessa Ortiz
> Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
> vanessa@redwood.ai
>
> 
On Thu, Aug 20, 2026 at 16:42:00 -0700 Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai> wrote:

> Vivek / team —
>
> Quick update after running the fee/waiver check with finance: we can align a pilot fee waiver for Nimbus provided: 1) the pilot is under 3 months, and 2) Nimbus signs the pilot MOU (1-page) that covers co-sell leads attribution and data-handling expectations. I’ve drafted a one-page MOU and uploaded it to the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GcpListingIntake).
>
> Also, ops confirmed the 5-business-day window for pulling SAML logs. To hit the mid-Oct timeline, we need the staging SSO tenant from Nimbus no later than Aug 26.
>
> Next steps (concise):
> - Vivek: run triage call (scheduling link in HubSpot) — target Wed Aug 19 10am PT
> - Maya / Nimbus: provide staging SSO tenant by Aug 26 and confirm pilot accounts
> - Karthik: raise RFC for canary rollback policy (if not already tracked)
> - Vanessa: review and sign-off on MOU language (Naomi uploaded draft)
>
> I’ll update HubSpot (contact record and GCP-123456). If we all agree, I’ll create the pilot MOU DocuSign and loop Nimbus legal.
>
> Naomi Feldman
> Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
> naomi@redwood.ai
>
> ---
> Attachments referenced: gcp_listing_checklist.xlsx (internal), evidence-scan_SAML.pdf (template), Nimbus_intake_notes.docx (external)
